ai_summary: Aqylon Nexus Limited announced a significant leadership transition with the simultaneous resignation of its Managing Director/Chairperson and Executive Director/CTO on September 3rd, 2026. The board promptly appointed Mr. Parth Rajeshbhai Rupareliya as the new Managing Director/Chairperson and Mr. Krunal Shaileshbhai Hapliya as an Additional Independent Director. A key red flag is the appointment of the new Managing Director, who is the cousin of an existing director, potentially raising corporate governance concerns regarding independence and succession planning.
